screening.reason: Exclusion 3: classifies ASD severity using structural MRI (FreeSurfer cortical morphological features, Desikan-Killiany atlas) from ABIDE II; no resting-state functional connectivity analysis is performed. Note: the paper's "Data availability" statement anomalously says "This work uses rs-fMRI data from the ABIDE-II dataset", which contradicts the abstract ("Morphological features are extracted from magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) scans") and the full methods (cortical thickness/curvature percentiles via FreeSurfer, DK atlas) — treated as a boilerplate/template error, not evidence of a resting-state analysis.
